learning_outcomes.text: Learn the identification and classification of porous materials.
Acquire knowledge of synthesis and modification methods necessary to control pore structure.
Learn characterization methods for porous materials.
Understand the applications of porous materials.
Gain information about recent developments in porous materials.

syllabus_topics: Porous Structures: Zeolites, Clay Minerals, and Other Natural Materials and Their Properties.
Determination of Properties of Natural and Synthetic Porous Materials.
